noun_definition: Workspace member refers to a user who has been invited to join a workspace but does not have administrative privileges, which affects their ability to edit categories within that workspace.
Option refers to the ability for a workspace member to edit categories within a workspace, which should not be available when all categories are disabled.

Categories refers to the organizational labels that can be assigned to expenses within a workspace, which in this Issue context are disabled for a non-admin member, preventing them from editing or viewing any categories.

Page refers to the interface displayed to a workspace member when attempting to edit categories in a workspace that has disabled all categories, which should indicate that no categories are enabled and provide guidance on how to proceed.
